title: Improving model.go Organization
description: A walkthrough of the current model.go structure and recommendations for better code organization and maintainability

steps.title: Current Model Structure
steps.description: The Model struct holds all TUI state including: application state (selecting, viewing, loading), dimensions (width, height), UI components (list, textInput), business logic components (navigator, walker, highlighter), and file content. This is a lot of responsibility for one struct.

steps.title: Update Method - Keyboard Handling
steps.description: The Update() method handles keyboard events, window resizing, file loading messages, and state transitions. It uses a switch statement on message type to dispatch to different handlers. The StateSelecting case handles list navigation and file selection.

steps.title: Update - Message Handling
steps.description: Update handles various tea messages including tea.WindowSizeMsg for responsive layout, walkthroughFilesMsg when walkthroughs are discovered, walkthroughLoadedMsg when a walkthrough is loaded, and fileContentMsg for displaying file contents.

steps.title: Types Package Overview
steps.description: The types.go file contains all core type definitions: AppState enum (StateSelecting, StateEnteringPath, StateLoading, StateViewing, StateLoadingStep), walkthroughItem for list display, Model struct with all state, and message types (walkthroughFilesMsg, errMsg, walkthroughLoadedMsg, fileContentMsg).

steps.title: Helpers Package
steps.description: The helpers.go file contains utility functions: displayWidth() calculates visual width handling Unicode properly, truncate() and truncateClean() for text fitting with/without ellipsis, and padRight() for padding. These are pure functions that could be tested independently.

steps.title: Loaders Package - Initialization
steps.description: loaders.go contains NewModel() which creates the initial TUI state, creates the list for walkthrough selection, text input for manual path entry, and initializes the walker, styles, and highlighter components.

steps.title: Loaders - Async File Loading
steps.description: The loaders also handle async operations: findWalkthroughFiles() searches for .wmti files and creates the self-referential template, loadWalkthrough() parses JSON walkthrough files, loadCurrentStepFile() reads the specific line range from the target file.

steps.title: View Package - State Rendering
steps.description: view.go contains the View() method which renders different states: StateSelecting shows the file list, StateEnteringPath shows text input, StateViewing shows the split code/sidebar view, StateLoadingStep shows step info while loading. Each state has dedicated rendering logic.

steps.title: View - Code Rendering with Highlighting
steps.description: The View method uses the highlighter to apply syntax highlighting to code. It calculates widths for the code area and sidebar, builds header/footer with keybindings, and renders highlighted tokens with proper width tracking for truncation.

steps.title: Styles Package
steps.description: styles.go defines the visual theme using Lipgloss. It includes styles for the header (file name, line range), footer (keybindings), sidebar (step info), code display, and various UI elements. SetDimensions() adjusts sizes based on terminal dimensions.

steps.title: Refactoring Recommendations
steps.description: After this refactoring, the internal/tui/ directory is well-organized: model.go (138 lines) handles Update state machine, types.go (65 lines) has all type definitions, helpers.go (87 lines) has utilities, loaders.go (148 lines) has initialization and async operations, view.go (250 lines) has rendering, styles.go (234 lines) has theming. Each file has a clear single responsibility.
